newsitem.title: LEBANON: Roadside bombs kill a man in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Roadside bombs kill a man in south Lebanon.

text.p: A Lebanese villager was killed and another wounded on Wednesday when four roadside bombs exploded near their pickup truck in the eastern Bekaa valley close to Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, security sources said.

Anti-Israeli Moslem guerrillas and Israeli troops frequently plant roadside bombs in south Lebanon in attempts to ambush each other. Many Shi'ite Moslem villagers are believed to be involved in guerrilla operations against the Israelis.

A spokesman for the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God), whose fighters are trying to drive Israel and its local militia allies from the south, issued a statement saying Israeli forces detonated the four bombs by remote control.
